scope: Node VM own-code state/storage/keyboard behavior; no browser automation

results.name: arrive at writing opens once; weather refresh cannot reopen a closed notebook
leaving closes panel and unsaved draft survives returning
explicit save persists Unicode text and timestamp; reload restores
HTML-looking memo is only a textarea value and never evaluated
storage failure keeps draft and previous saved record; retry works
blocked or malformed storage does not break interaction
restored and programmatically supplied values are bounded to500
arrows/digits stop at notebook, Korean composition Escape does not close
Ctrl+S saves locally and empty note can be explicitly saved
